facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src_python/.create_sensor_suite: create a SensorSuite instance to hold all agent sensors as a dictionary keyed by UUID
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src_python/.add_sensor_to_suite: add a habitat_sim sensor to the SensorSuite using the add method which keys by sensor UUID
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src_python/.lookup_sensor_by_uuid: lookup a sensor in the SensorSuite dictionary by its specification UUID string key
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src_python/.review_sensor_suite_class: review the SensorSuite class which extends Dict to hold agent sensors with an add helper method
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src_python/.summarize_sensor_suite: summarize the SensorSuite class that wraps a dictionary of sensors indexed by their UUID

facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src_python/.draw_observation: draw a sensor observation to the framebuffer using the SimulatorBackend renderer
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src_python/.get_observation: get the rendered observation from the sensor framebuffer with noise model applied
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src_python/.render_async: enqueue a sensor draw job for asynchronous rendering with the simulator renderer
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src_python/.get_observation_async: get the observation from a sensor after an async render job completes
facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src_python/.close_sensor: close a sensor wrapper and release references to the simulator and sensor object
